description.en: Extensible and accessible component library designed for modern web startups.
description.zh: 专为现代科技初创团队打造的高扩展性、无障碍优先的 React 组件系统。

content.en: Nex UI is a modern, extensible React component library engineered for fast-paced startup workflows. Built with accessibility at its core and styled via Tailwind CSS, it offers a complete design language with cohesive typography, robust forms, and intuitive dialogs.
content.zh: Nex UI 是一套面向敏捷科技团队打造的无障碍优先 React UI 组件库。以 Tailwind CSS 作为样式层，拥有统一协调的设计语言规范，涵盖了从基础表单输入、交互式浮层到多层级中后台导航，具备优秀的类型提示与开箱即用的开发人体工学。
